subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who makes an eloquent public speech
solution:
The correct answer is **"Orator"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The original meaning refers to someone who is capable of making a very smooth and fluent public speech.
 
• **Orator:** someone who is good at public speaking.
 
 
• **Example:** Ma
